Functional Modules

Engineered With Complete Operational Modules

Everything required to coordinate frontline operators, parts inventory, accounting, and customer communication in Inventory IQ.

SKU & Catalog Master

Organize items with hierarchical categories, brands, variants, units of measurement (UOM), and HSN codes.

Multi-Location Warehousing

Manage multiple bins, shelves, and regional warehouses. Perform seamless inter-warehouse stock transfer orders (STO).

Purchase Orders & GRN

Issue POs to vendors, track partial shipments, and log Goods Received Notes (GRN) with strict quality inspection.

Batch & Expiry Control

First-in, first-out (FIFO) and First-Expiry, First-Out (FEFO) automated dispatch policies to prevent obsolete stock.

Barcode & QR Infrastructure

Generate printable barcode labels and scan using mobile devices or wireless scanners during receiving and dispatch.

Valuation & Profitability Analytics

Real-time stock valuation using Moving Average Cost or FIFO methods, dead stock analysis, and stock movement heatmaps.

End-to-End Workflow

How Information Flows From Arrival to Handover

Eliminate manual bottlenecks with an automated 5-step operational pipeline.

01

Procurement & PO

Create vendor purchase order with agreed unit pricing and tax terms.

02

Goods Receipt (GRN)

Scan arriving items, verify physical count vs invoice, and assign warehouse bins.

03

Real-time Balancing

Stock quantities update immediately across sales channels and warehouses.

04

Dispatch & Picking

Generate pick lists, pack slips, and delivery challans with barcode verification.

05

Reorder Automation

Smart algorithms calculate reorder levels based on sales velocity and lead time.

Stakeholder Value

Tailored Value for Every Business Persona

Different team members interact with the software differently. Here is how each role benefits.

Warehouse Manager

Accurate bin-level visibility and fast pick-and-pack workflows with zero misplacement.

Procurement Lead

Automated low-stock alerts, supplier price comparison, and on-time PO generation.

Business Owner

Reduced tied-up capital in dead stock and accurate real-time inventory asset valuation.

Security & Role-Based Governance

Access policies can be scoped by role and workflow. The permissions needed for your team should be confirmed during product evaluation and setup.

  • Hosting and encryption controls confirmed per deployment
  • Backup and recovery arrangements defined for the selected service
  • Audit history can be scoped to relevant workflows

3 to 10-Day Implementation & Staff Onboarding

We know your business cannot stop for software upgrades. Our onboarding team provides turnkey data migration from your existing spreadsheets, hardware integration (barcode guns/printers), and live staff training.

  • Automated CSV/Excel import templates for SKU catalogs & customer databases
  • Personalized screen share training for advisors, cashiers & managers
  • Dedicated deployment manager during your first two weeks of go-live
